measured.profile: Intel(R) Arc(TM) B370 GPU / Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 338H, driver 101.8509, Vulkan 1.4.335, FIFO 60 Hz
measured.protocol: 12 sessions x 5 pinned runs (60 runs), 60 s preheat, 6 min between sessions, 2 sessions after a broad rebuild
measured.rule: 1980 (3-session baseline, 1 candidate session) combinations; k=3 (bootstrap false-fail upper 95 % bound 0.00 %), cpu 5 %, gpu 10 %, smallest dispersion_factor with inconclusive <= 10 % (4: 2.83 %, bootstrap upper 8.24 %)
measured.demoted: passes.shadow.gpu_ms is report-only: at the Spec defaults it is the only metric that false-fails (6.1 % of combinations; its session medians span 2.30 to 2.81 ms, a per-session shift larger than 10 %), and no other metric fails
measured.mdr: a single-session baseline resolves cpu 5.1-6.5 % and gpu 10.5-16.1 % (90 % detection), counters exact
measured.canary: the fixed GPU canary (ADR-0120; settle_seconds 3: right after a benchmark child exits the first canary repetitions read about 2.4 x slow and are normal about a second later (a canary started at once after a session, max repetition 8.6-9.3 ms against 3.8 ms; started 2 s later, max under 4.2 ms), and with the 3 s settle eight readings over four simulated sessions spread alu 0.8 %, bw 1.9 %, tex 0.5 %; Spec 0060 third Correction 2026-10-15): max_shift_pct 8 is about 3 x the largest spread of its readings across separate child runs on the reference machine (alu 0.1-1.2 %, bw 1.7-2.9 %, tex 0.9-1.2 % over ten runs each, before and after serializing the repetitions), far below the shifts it must catch (the slow GPU state read the memory-bound components about 2.1 x); record.max_canary_spread_pct 5 allows a recording about 1.7 x that spread. Whether the canary tracks the state that moves the main pass is validated live at the first acceptance run, not here
measured.record_bar: record-time bar on a 3-session baseline's minimum detectable regression: cpu 10 %, gpu 20 %. Of the 220 three-session baselines the 12 calibration sessions allow, cpu resolves 5.4-6.5 % (bar 10 % refuses none) and gpu 10.6-19.1 % (p99 17.2 %; bar 20 % refuses none); the two recordings that motivated the bar resolve cpu 18.2 % and gpu 21.5 % (a recording spanning battery and mains) and are refused
measured.cores: pin_process restricts the child to one logical processor, the highest-numbered of the highest efficiency class (Spec 0060 eighth Correction 2026-10-26): on the AMD reference desktop (Ryzen 7 9700X, 8 logical processors) the render thread, free to move, woke from the frame's fence wait cold or warm by machine state (all 8 processors: RenderExtraction p50 0.389-0.714 ms in two levels, cpu_active_ms 1.73-2.07; one processor: 0.710-0.801 and 2.05-2.16; the fence wait spinning: 0.342-0.369 and 1.56-1.64); per processor, 6 runs, cpu_active_ms 2.05-2.17 with spreads 1.0-3.5 % except processor 0 (1.80-1.85, kept warm by the system's interrupt work); processor 7 1.0 %. Before it, the fifth Correction (2026-10-17) restricted the child to the highest-efficiency-class cores: on the Intel laptop (4 P, 4 E, 4 LP-E), cpu_active_ms p50 P 9.21-9.53 ms, P+E 9.31-9.56, LP-E 10.93-11.25, E 11.09-12.82, all cores 9.47-10.98; without it a 20-gate acceptance gave 17 fail
measured.gpu_report_only: the GPU tier gates nothing (Spec 0060 sixth Correction 2026-10-17): gated.gpu is empty, gpu_busy_ms and passes.*.gpu_ms are reported, dispersion_metrics is cpu_active_ms, canary.required is false (the canary stays in the code and is switched back on with the GPU tier). Evidence: the baseline recorded for the first commit has 15 runs of which 9 read gpu_busy_ms 16.5-16.8 ms (Opaque 12.3-12.6) and 6 read 17.3-19.7 (Opaque 13.2-15.3); 9 live gates on it gave 3 pass / 6 fail, all on passes.Opaque.gpu_ms and passes.draw.gpu_ms (+9-15 %), with cpu_active_ms within +1.2 % and the canary within 0.3 % of its reference every time; a gate after 15 minutes idle read 18.81 ms (heat soak refuted)
measured.dispersion_rule: the dispersion check can make a verdict inconclusive only on dispersion_metrics (cpu_active_ms, gpu_busy_ms); with every gated CPU/GPU metric checked, 20 live gates on the accepted baseline gave 5 inconclusive (25 %); replayed exactly the headline-only rule gives 1 of 20, with false-fail equal to the control and detection not lower (offline study, Spec 0060 second Correction 2026-10-14)
